shortBio.en: AC/DC vocalist from 1980; Back in Black relaunches the Young brothers’ method at global FM scale.
shortBio.zh: 1980 年起 AC/DC 主唱；Back in Black 把 Young 兄弟的方法重启到全球 FM 尺度。

whyHub.en: Replacement singer who keeps the brand’s riff system intact—textbook counterexample to ‘logo without the voice.’
whyHub.zh: 替换主唱却保住品牌 riff 系统——「没有那把嗓的 logo」的教科书反例。

body.en:
Ex-Geordie singer. Higher, raspier bark than Scott. Back in Black (1980) is the proof that AC/DC’s chassis survived the swap.

Later hearing issues pause touring; returns for selected runs.
body.zh:
前 Geordie 主唱。比 Scott 更高、更沙的吠叫。Back in Black（1980）证明 AC/DC 底盘扛住了替换。

后期听力问题暂停巡演；选定巡演再归队。
